Yō Kitazawa (Japanese: 北沢洋 Kitazawa Yō) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Kitazawa was born on July 9, 1963, in , . He became a voice actor as an adult and mostly got minor roles. He provided the voice of Ninja Village elder , during of the . Kitazawa is currently affiliated with Ken Production.
